name: FallCon
blurb: An annual three-day board game and miniatures convention in Calgary, running since 1987, with hosted play, exhibitors, an auction and the Canadian Game Design Awards.
notes: FallCon 39 ran Aug 21-23, 2026 (Telus Convention Centre) -- already finished before today (2026-10-05) -- and the site's own homepage says outright 'Thank you for an amazing FallCon 39. Stay tuned for FallCon 40 dates', i.e. the organizers have not announced the next edition yet; a web search likewise turned up no FallCon 40 date. The only dated JSON-LD on the page is for a separate, smaller 'FallCon FleaMarket' sub-event (2026-04-25, Sunalta Community Hall), also already past and not the three-day convention itself, so it is not used as the edition. Per the no-date-announced rule, editions is left empty.
